definitions: An Athenian lawgiver of the 7th century BC, known for his harsh legal code.
A constellation in the northern sky, representing a dragon.
A genus of gliding lizards native to Southeast Asia.
A character in the Harry Potter series, Draco Malfoy.
examples: The constellation Draco is circumpolar for many northern observers.
The Draco lizard can glide between trees.
Draco Malfoy was a student in Slytherin house.
